description: This file defines types, utility functions, and exports related to legacy configuration handling in a TypeScript project. It includes types for configuration rules and migrations, functions for safely manipulating nested record structures, parsing legacy audio transcription commands, and managing agents within configuration objects.

methods.name: getRecord
methods.description: Retrieves a record from a value if it is a record, otherwise returns null.

methods.name: ensureRecord
methods.description: Ensures that a given key in a root object is a record, creating an empty record if necessary.

methods.name: mergeMissing
methods.description: Merges missing properties from source into target recursively, skipping undefined values and blocked keys.

methods.name: mapLegacyAudioTranscription
methods.description: Parses a legacy audio transcription command object, validating and returning a structured command object or null.

methods.name: getAgentsList
methods.description: Extracts the list of agents from a raw agents record.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentIdFromRaw
methods.description: Determines the default agent ID from raw configuration, falling back to main when necessary.

methods.name: ensureAgentEntry
methods.description: Ensures an agent entry with a given ID exists in a list, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: defineLegacyConfigMigration
methods.description: Returns the provided migration object, possibly used for typing or registration purposes.
